{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent negative sentiment, as models tend to overreact to pessimism.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when sentiment is stable (e.g., 0.00 over multiple days) — forecasts drift too high.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is positive (e.g., >0.00) but price is trending downward — models overestimate recovery.",
    "Correct for lagged forecasts: if true price drops after a forecast peak, reduce next forecast by 5–10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is falling, reduce forecast by 3–5% to avoid overconfidence in rebound.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 1–2% downward adjustment if recent 5-day average is below 30-day average — avoid overestimating continuation."
  ]
}
